lead.t: Indirect haemagglutination (IHA) test is the most sensitive “sensitivity 83-100%”

snip.t: Indirect haemagglutination (IHA) test is the most sensitive “sensitivity 83-100%”
Serology (indirect haemagglutination or ELISA): positive in most patients with invasive disease and liver abscess; negative in asymptomatic carriers and may take about a week to turn positive.
